title: Night-time recorder failure reported late creates a new report version
description: All north recorders die every night at 18:00 and restart at 06:00, but keep declaring complete uploads, so report v1 scores the north night rate as zero (covered, nothing heard) and the comparison looks significant. When field staff later declare the gaps, a new report at a new cutoff marks the north nights unknown; the old report stays exactly reproducible at its own cutoff.

expected.note: 6 north day events + 12 south events; north night calls are never recorded
